event_detail: Toaster/bread: the empty gripper hovers just to the right of the bread slice sticking out of the toaster for 4.8 s, without closing on the bread or pressing a lever.
evidence: Left shoulder view: the arm pose barely changes across the four frames, gripper beside the bread above the toaster's right half. Zoomed toaster front: the left lever sits at the top of its slot and the bread stands fully up out of the slot in every frame. Wrist camera: the bread slice is in view above the fingers, not between them, shifting only slightly. The plate is empty. I cannot tell from these frames whether the toaster was already run and popped up (which would make stage 1 done); with the lever up and no sign of toasting I mark stage 1 as not done, low confidence.
